t: Workflows to Redirect & Fix Your Attention
s: This article advocates for using custom tools like Pipulate to combat attention-hijacking by social media and advertising, promoting intentional input for personal growth and client success through structured workflows.
sub: Combating the attention economy via intentional input and self-directed workflows.
Utilizing Pipulate for structured client narrative creation and data analysis with Botify.
The role of journaling and mindful processing in regaining autonomy from algorithmic influence.
